service.ur: وراثت میں ملی جائیداد کی رجسٹریشن

about: Transfer a property from a deceased owner to the heirs under a court inheritance document.
note: Requirements read from the official Dubai Land Department service page on the checked date. The sign-in forms do not publish their field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Register inherited property. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Any person may apply, not only an heir
Documents issued outside the UAE must be attested and, if not in Arabic, legally translated
documents: Inheritance certificate or declaration endorsed by the UAE courts
Emirates IDs of resident heirs, passport copies for non-resident heirs
Bank NOC for a mortgaged property
Developer NOC for a property under construction
fees: AED 1,000 per property for inheritance registration
AED 130 plus VAT service partner fee
